title: All AI-generated code should be Open Source
llm_summary: The article argues that any code produced by AI tools—whether from large‑language models, code‑generation assistants, or automated refactoring utilities—should be released under an open‑source license, because the underlying models are trained on publicly available code and developers benefit from transparent, reusable outputs.
